messages:
Priya: quick a11y pass request before the analytics table goes GA. main asks: 1) contrast for the muted cell labels in compact row mode, 2) persistent focus outline when resizing columns, 3) how toast messages are announced to SRs (they're currently silent). Leo: good catch on the muted labels. in compact mode the CSS sets color: var(--muted-3); which is ~3.2:1 on a #ffffff bg. needs to be >= 4.5:1. propose bumping to var(--muted-1) or use a semibold weight. Jordan: agree. prefer color change over weight for consistent typography. also add a hover state with higher contrast for interactive cells. Will add suggested hex values. Anya: for focus: when you resize a column the grab handle is focusable but the outline disappears because transform: translateZ(0) creates a stacking context. tried `outline-offset: 3px` but it still clips. anyone seen this? Leo: yeah clipping is usually from overflow: hidden on the table container. either remove overflow or move the handle outside the overflow. alternative: use box-shadow for focus instead of outline, e.g.: ``` .col-resize-handle:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,120,212,0.24); } ``` Priya: that box-shadow approach looks promising cross-browser. please keep the color accessible for both light and dark themes. Dee (QA): Toast announcements: steps to repro - trigger save on query -> toast shows "Saved" -> VoiceOver doesn't announce. Looks like toasts are not in the DOM long enough or lack role="status" / aria-live. Current markup: `
Saved
`. Jordan: toasts should use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` for non-urgent messages, and `aria-atomic="true"` so the whole message is read. for urgent errors use `aria-live="assertive"`. also ensure they aren't aria-hidden or inert. Priya: suggested snippet: ```
Saved
``` And make sure to insert into DOM after reflow, not inside an element with `aria-hidden="true"`. Anya: another minor: table header sort buttons currently read "sort" + chevron icon. SR reads "Name sort" then "ascending" which is fine, but the visual tooltip shows just "Sort". could be confusing. maybe label should be `aria-label="Sort by Name: ascending"` on the button. Jordan: prefer `aria-pressed` or `aria-sort` on the TH depending on pattern. If using button inside th, `aria-label` with current state is ok. If using `th` as interactive, set `aria-sort` to "ascending" / "descending". Leo: cross-theme contrast proposal for muted labels: light theme #6b6b6b (4.6:1), dark theme #cfcfcf (4.7:1). sharing palette PR in a bit. Dee (QA): accessibility test matrix I'm running: Chrome+NVDA, Safari+VoiceOver, Firefox+NVDA. noted two regressions so far: toasts silent on VoiceOver and focus handle clipped in Firefox when container has `overflow:auto`. filing tickets. aria-bot: Accessibility reminder: ensure text contrast >=4.5:1, non-text UI contrast >=3:1, toasts use role/status or aria-live, focus indicators visible and not solely color dependent. See https://a11y-checklist.local/notifications. Priya: thanks — action items: Leo opens palette PR with suggested hexes, Jordan updates toast component and adds aria-atomic/role, Anya looks at moving handle outside overflow or switch to box-shadow focus, Dee files the Firefox overflow follow-up and will regress test once PRs land. I'll add this to the release a11y checklist. Leo: PR #3622 opened: palette + compact-row contrast tweaks. cc @Priya for visual review. Jordan: will push a small patch for toast semantics and table button aria changes today. Anya: good plan. please paste PR links here so QA can re-run. closing once Dee verifies VoiceOver announces toast and the focus outline persists on resize.
